newsitem.title: JAPAN: North Korea announces deaths of two officials.
newsitem.headline: North Korea announces deaths of two officials.

text.p: North Korea's official media has reported the death of two alternate members of the central committee of the ruling Workers Party, the news agency Radiopress said on Monday.

Kim Jae-bong, 72, died of illness on February 14 and Li Won-kwan, 79, also died of illness on February 24, the ruling party newspaper Minju Chosun said in reports dated late February, Radiopress said.
Kim, who served as ambassador to the Soviet Union in the late 1970s and to Denmark from 1992-94, was ranked 190th in the July 1994 funeral committee rankings for late President Kim Il-sung.
Li managed a major car factory for most of his career and was ranked 213 on the same funeral list, the report said.
The death announcements follow those of Defence Minister Choe Kwang, and his deputy Kim Kwang-jin, who died within a week of each other last month.
Radiopress is an independent group that monitors North Korean media.
